During T2, starting after at least one CSI-RS transmission occasion for channel measurement and reporting from the slot specified in clause 4.3 of TS 38.213 [8] and until the UE has completed the SCell activation, the UE shall report out-of-range if the UE has available uplink resources to report CQI for the SCell.

During T2, the UE shall send the first valid CSI report (non-zero CQI) for the SCell in first available uplink resource for CSI reporting no later than slot *m +* (THARQ+Tactivation\_time\_withCCA + TCSI\_Reporting\_withCCA)/NR\_slot\_length, where Tactivation\_time\_withCCA = TFirstSSB\_MAX + L2,1*TSMTC\_MAX + (1 +L2,2)*Trs + 5ms, as specified in TS 38.133 [6] clause 8.3A.2.

During T3, the UE shall stop sending CSI reports for SCell at latest in slot  $n+\frac{T_{HARQ}+3ms}{NR slot length}$ , as defined in TS 38.133 [6] clause 8.3A.3.

During T2, interruption on PCell shall not occur outside slot m +1+ $\frac{T_{HARQ}}{NR slot length}$   to slot m +1+ $\frac{T_{HARQ}+3+T_{X}}{NR slot length}$ with TX = TFirstSSB\_MAX + L2,1* TSMTC\_MAX.

During T3, interruption on PCell shall not occur outside slot *n* +1+THARQ/NR\_slot\_length to slot *n* +1+(THARQ +3ms)/NR\_slot\_length.

The interruption on PCell shall not be more than specified for SA in TS 38.133 [6] clause 8.2.2.2.2.

The rate of correctly observed SCell activation delays and SCell deactivation delays shall for repeated tests be at least 90%.

##### 13.2.2.3	NR SA FR1 SCell Activation and Deactivation of unknown SCell under CCA

###### 13.2.2.3.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that SCell activation and deactivation delays for SCell, with PCell and SCell under CCA, are within the requirements stated in clause 13.2.2.0.1, when the SCell is unknown to the UE at the time of activation.

###### 13.2.2.3.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with a shared spectrum NR carrier.

###### 13.2.2.3.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.2.2.0.1 for SCell Activation Delay Requirement for Deactivated SCell under CCA and SCell Deactivation Delay Requirement for Activated SCell under CCA correspondingly.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.2.2.3.

###### 13.2.2.3.4	Test description

Same test description as described in section 13.2.2.1.4.

###### 13.2.2.3.4.1	Initial conditions

Same initial conditions as described in section 13.2.2.1.4.1 with following exception:

-	The listed parameter values in Tables 13.2.2.3.4.1-3 will replace the values of corresponding parameters in Tables 13.2.2.1.4.1-3.

Table 13.2.2.3.4.1-3: General test parameters for NR SA FR1 SCell Activation and Deactivation of unknown SCell under CCA

| Parameter   | Unit   |   Value | Comment                                                                                      |
|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| T1          | s      |     0.1 | During this time period the PCell shall be known and the SCell configured, but not detected. |

###### 13.2.2.3.4.2	Test procedure

Same test procedure as described in section 13.2.2.1.4.2, except step 3 and step 5 are replaced by following steps:

3.	T1 starts. Immediately after, the SS shall configure SCell (Cell 2) on the SCC as per TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 7.5.1. The SCell (Cell 2) shall be powered OFF till T2 starts.

5.	The SS activates SCC by sending the activation MAC-CE (Refer TS 38.321 [12], clauses 5.9, 6.1.3.10) in a slot # denoted m, power ON the SCell (Cell2), T2 starts in slot m. If the SS receives ACK for MAC-CE sent by the UE, the test proceeds to step 6, otherwise go to step 9.

and:

- Step 3a is removed.

During T2, the UE shall send the first CSI report for SCell after at least one CSI-RS transmission occasion for channel measurement and reporting after slot m+1+ $\frac{T_{HARQ}+3ms}{NR slot length}$  and no later than slot m+1+ $\frac{T_{HARQ}+3ms+T_{CSI \_ Reporting \_ withCCA}}{NR slot length}$ .

During T2, conditioned on that downlink CCA failures L3,1 and L3,2 experienced in the SCell fulfill L3,1 ≤ L3,1,max and L3,2 ≤ L3,2,max with L3,1,max = 2 and L3,2,max = 2, respectively, the UE shall send the first valid CSI report (non-zero CQI) for the SCell no later than slot m+ $\frac{T_{HARQ}+T_{activation \_ time \_ withCCA}+T_{CSI \_ Reporting \_ withCCA}}{NR slot length}$ , where Tactivation\_time\_withCCA = TFirstSSB\_MAX + (1 + L3,1)*TSMTC\_MAX + (2 + L3,2)*Trs + 5ms and TCSI\_reporting\_withCCA = TCSI\_reporting + TCSI\_ReportingDelay, as specified in TS 38.133 [6] clause 8.3A.2.

During T3, the UE shall stop sending CSI reports for SCell at latest in slot  $n+\frac{T_{HARQ}+3ms}{NR slot length}$ , as defined in TS 38.133 [6] clause 8.3A.3.

During T2, interruption on PCell shall not occur outside slot m +1+ $\frac{T_{HARQ}}{NR slot length}$   to slot m +1+ $\frac{T_{HARQ}+3+T_{X}}{NR slot length}$ with TX = TFirstSSB.

During T3, interruption on PCell shall not occur outside slot *n* +1+THARQ/NR\_slot\_length to slot *n* +1+(THARQ +3ms)/NR\_slot\_length.

The interruption on PCell shall not be more than specified for SA in TS 38.133 [6] clause 8.2.2.2.2.

The rate of correctly observed SCell activation delays and SCell deactivation delays shall for repeated tests be at least 90%.

##### 13.3.1.1	NR SA FR1 Event-triggered reporting tests on SCC under CCA without gaps under non-DRX

###### 13.3.1.1.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event. This test will partly verify the intra-frequency cell search requirements in clauses 13.3.1.0.1.1 and 13.3.1.0.1.2.

###### 13.3.1.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with an unlicensed carrier and RRM measurements on shared channel access.

###### 13.3.1.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.3.1.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.3.1.1.

###### 13.3.1.1.4	Test description

Three cells are deployed in the test, which are FR1 PCell (Cell 1), and two cells on the same carrier frequency with CCA and transmit SSBs in DBT windows according to DL CCA model: SCell (Cell 2) and a neighbour cell (Cell 3). The test parameters for the three cells are given in Table 13.3.1.1.4.1-1 and 13.3.1.1.4.1-3 below. In the measurement control information, a measurement object is configured for the frequency of the SCell, and it is indicated to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event A3 is used.

###### 13.3.1.1.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 13.3.1.1.4.1-1.

###### 13.3.1.1.4.2	Test procedure

The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1 and T2, respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of Cell 3. The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test.

1.	Ensure the UE is in State RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5. Both Cell 1 (PCell) and Cell 2 (SCell) are configured on the UE.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 13.3.1.1.5-1.

3.	SS shall transmit an *RRCConnectionReconfiguration* message with event A3 configured with the corresponding offset according to Table 13.3.1.1.4.1-3.

4.	The UE shall transmit *RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete* message. The SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.3.1.1.5-1. T1 starts.

5.	When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 13.3.1.1.5-1. T2 starts.

6.	UE shall transmit a *MeasurementReport* message triggered by Event A3. If the overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 842 ms, then the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the required measurement delay, then the number of failure tests is increased by one.

7.	After the SS receive the *MeasurementReport* message in step 6) or when T2 expires, the SS shall:

-	transmit *RRCRelease* message to release the RRC connection.

OR

-	switch the UE off.

8.	The SS shall disable the CCA model (both DL and UL, i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1). Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 3) mod 1008) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

9.	Depending on the choice in Step 7, the SS:

-	if the RRC Connection Release has been sent, transmits in Cell 1 a *Paging* message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE),
OR:

-	if the device has been switched off, switches on the UE.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

The UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than Tidentify\_intra\_without\_index\_CCA ms from the beginning of time period T2. The UE is not required to read the neighbour cell SSB index in this test. The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

Tidentify\_intra\_cca\_without\_index = (TPSS/SSS\_sync\_intra\_cca + T SSB\_measurement\_period\_intra\_cca) ms, where

TPSS/SSS\_sync\_intra\_cca: it is the time period used in PSS/SSS detection given in table 10.4.1.0.1.1-1.

T SSB\_measurement\_period\_intra\_cca: equal to a measurement period of SSB based measurement given in table 10.4.1.0.1.2-1.

NOTE:	The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

##### 13.3.1.2	NR SA FR1 Event-triggered reporting tests on SCC under CCA without gaps under DRX

###### 13.3.1.2.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event. This test will partly verify the intra-frequency cell search requirements in clauses 13.3.1.0.1.1 and 13.3.1.0.1.2.

###### 13.3.1.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with an unlicensed carrier, RRM measurements on shared channel access and long DRX cycle.

###### 13.3.1.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.3.1.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.3.1.2.

###### 13.3.1.2.4	Test description

Three cells are deployed in the test, which are FR1 PCell (Cell 1), and two cells on the same carrier frequency with CCA and transmit SSBs in DBT windows according to DL CCA model: SCell (Cell 2) and a neighbour cell (Cell 3). The test parameters for the three cells are given in Table 13.3.1.2.4.1-1 and 13.3.1.2.4.1-3 below. In the measurement control information, a measurement object is configured for the frequency of the SCell, and it is indicated to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event A3 is used.

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 13.3.1.2.4.1-1.

###### 13.3.1.2.4.2	Test procedure

The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1 and T2, respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of Cell 3. The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test.

UE needs to be provided at least once every 500ms with new Timing Advance Command MAC control element to restart the Time alignment timer to keep UE uplink time alignment. Furthermore, UE is allocated with PUSCH resource at every DRX cycle. In Test 2 when DRX = 640 ms is used, the uplink time alignment is not maintained and the UE needs to use RACH to obtain uplink allocation for measurement reporting.

1.	Ensure the UE is in State RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5. Both Cell 1 (PCell) and Cell 2 (SCell) are configured on the UE.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 13.3.1.2.5-1.

3.	SS shall transmit an *RRCConnectionReconfiguration* message with event A3 configured with the corresponding offset according to Table 13.3.1.2.4.1-3.

4.	The UE shall transmit *RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete* message. The SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.3.1.2.5-1. T1 starts.

5.	When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 13.3.1.2.5-1. T2 starts.

6.	UE shall transmit a *MeasurementReport* message triggered by Event A3. If the overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 1442 ms for Test 1 or less than 10242 ms for Test 2, then the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the required measurement delay, then the number of failure tests is increased by one.

7.	After the SS receive the *MeasurementReport* message in step 6) or when T2 expires, the SS shall:

-	transmit *RRCRelease* message to release the RRC connection.

OR

-	switch the UE off.

8.	The SS shall disable the CCA model (both DL and UL, i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1). Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 3) mod 1008) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

9.	Depending on the choice in Step 7, the SS:

-	if the RRC Connection Release has been sent, transmits in Cell 1 a *Paging* message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE),
OR:

-	if the device has been switched off, switches on the UE.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

11.	Repeat step 1-10 for each sub-test in Tables 13.3.1.2.4.1-3 and 13.3.1.2.5-1 as appropriate.

The UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than Tidentify\_intra\_without\_index\_CCA ms from the beginning of time period T2. The UE is not required to read the neighbour cell SSB index in this test. The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

Tidentify\_intra\_cca\_without\_index = (TPSS/SSS\_sync\_intra\_cca + T SSB\_measurement\_period\_intra\_cca) ms, where

TPSS/SSS\_sync\_intra\_cca: it is the time period used in PSS/SSS detection given in 10.4.1.0.1.1-1.

T SSB\_measurement\_period\_intra\_cca: equal to a measurement period of SSB based measurement given in table 10.4.1.0.1.2-1.

NOTE:	The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

##### 13.3.1.3	NR SA FR1 Event-triggered reporting tests on SCC under CCA with per-UE gaps under non-DRX

###### 13.3.1.3.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event. This test will partly verify the intra-frequency cell search requirements in clauses 13.3.1.0.2.1 and 13.3.1.0.2.2.

###### 13.3.1.3.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with an unlicensed carrier, RRM measurements on shared channel access and BWP operation without bandwidth restriction.

###### 13.3.1.3.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.3.1.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.3.1.3.

###### 13.3.1.3.4	Test description

Three cells are deployed in the test, which are FR1 PCell (Cell 1), and two cells on the same carrier frequency with CCA and transmit SSBs in DBT windows according to DL CCA model: SCell (Cell 2) and a neighbour cell (Cell 3). The test parameters for the three cells are given in Table 13.3.1.3.4.1-1 and 13.3.1.3.4.1-3 below. In the measurement control information, a measurement object is configured for the frequency of the SCell, and it is indicated to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event A3 is used.

###### 13.3.1.3.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 13.3.1.3.4.1-1.

###### 13.3.1.3.4.2	Test procedure

The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1 and T2, respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of Cell 3. The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test.

There are two BWPs configured in Cell 1, BWP0 which contains the cell defining SSB, and BWP1 which does not contain any SSB of Cell 1. During the whole test, BWP1 is always scheduled as the active BWP for the UE.

1.	Ensure the UE is in State RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5. Both Cell 1 (PCell) and Cell 2 (SCell) are configured on the UE.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 13.3.1.3.5-1.

3.	SS shall transmit an *RRCConnectionReconfiguration* message with event A3 configured with the corresponding offset according to Table 13.3.1.3.4.1-3.

4.	The UE shall transmit *RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete* message. The SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.3.1.3.5-1. T1 starts.

5.	When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 13.3.1.3.5-1. T2 starts.

6.	UE shall transmit a *MeasurementReport* message triggered by Event A3. If the overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 1082 ms, then the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the required measurement delay, then the number of failure tests is increased by one.

7.	After the SS receive the *MeasurementReport* message in step 6) or when T2 expires, the SS shall:

-	transmit *RRCRelease* message to release the RRC connection.

OR

-	switch the UE off.

8.	The SS shall disable the CCA model (both DL and UL, i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1). Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 3) mod 1008) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

9.	Depending on the choice in Step 7, the SS:

-	if the RRC Connection Release has been sent, transmits in Cell 1 a *Paging* message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE),
OR:

-	if the device has been switched off, switches on the UE.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

The UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than Tidentify\_intra\_without\_index\_CCA ms from the beginning of time period T2. The UE is not required to read the neighbour cell SSB index in this test. The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

Tidentify\_intra\_cca\_without\_index = (TPSS/SSS\_sync\_intra\_cca + T SSB\_measurement\_period\_intra\_cca) ms, where

TPSS/SSS\_sync\_intra\_cca: it is the time period used in PSS/SSS detection given in table 10.4.1.0.2.1-1.

T SSB\_measurement\_period\_intra\_cca: equal to a measurement period of SSB based measurement given in table 10.4.1.0.2.2-1.

NOTE:	The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

##### 13.3.1.4	NR SA FR1 Event-triggered reporting tests on SCC under CCA with per-UE gaps under DRX

###### 13.3.1.4.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event. This test will partly verify the intra-frequency cell search requirements in clauses 13.3.1.0.2.1 and 13.3.1.0.2.2.

###### 13.3.1.4.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with an unlicensed carrier, RRM measurements on shared channel access, BWP operation without bandwidth restriction and long DRX cycle.

###### 13.3.1.4.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.3.1.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.3.1.4.

###### 13.3.1.4.4	Test description

Three cells are deployed in the test, which are FR1 PCell (Cell 1), and two cells on the same carrier frequency with CCA and transmit SSBs in DBT windows according to DL CCA model: SCell (Cell 2) and a neighbour cell (Cell 3). The test parameters for the three cells are given in Table 13.3.1.4.4.1-1 and 13.3.1.4.4.1-3 below. In the measurement control information, a measurement object is configured for the frequency of the SCell, and it is indicated to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event A3 is used.

###### 13.3.1.4.4.2	Test procedure

The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1 and T2, respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of Cell 3. The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test.

There are two BWPs configured in Cell 1, BWP0 which contains the cell defining SSB, and BWP1 which does not contain any SSB of Cell 1. During the whole test, BWP1 is always scheduled as the active BWP for the UE.

UE needs to be provided at least once every 500ms with new Timing Advance Command MAC control element to restart the Time alignment timer to keep UE uplink time alignment. Furthermore, UE is allocated with PUSCH resource at every DRX cycle. In Test 2 when DRX = 640 ms is used, the uplink time alignment is not maintained and the UE needs to use RACH to obtain uplink allocation for measurement reporting.

1.	Ensure the UE is in State RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5. Both Cell 1 (PCell) and Cell 2 (SCell) are configured on the UE.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 13.3.1.4.5-1.

3.	SS shall transmit an *RRCConnectionReconfiguration* message with event A3 configured with the corresponding offset according to Table 13.3.1.4.4.1-3.

4.	The UE shall transmit *RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete* message. The SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.3.1.4.5-1. T1 starts.

5.	When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 13.3.1.4.5-1. T2 starts.

6.	UE shall transmit a *MeasurementReport* message triggered by Event A3. If the overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 1442 ms for Test 1 or less than 10242 ms for Test 2, then the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the required measurement delay, then the number of failure tests is increased by one.

7.	After the SS receive the *MeasurementReport* message in step 6) or when T2 expires, the SS shall:

-	transmit *RRCRelease* message to release the RRC connection.

OR

-	switch the UE off.

8.	The SS shall disable the CCA model (both DL and UL, i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1). Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 3) mod 1008) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

9.	Depending on the choice in Step 7, the SS:

-	if the RRC Connection Release has been sent, transmits in Cell 1 a *Paging* message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE),
OR:

-	if the device has been switched off, switches on the UE.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

11.	Repeat step 1-10 for each sub-test in Tables 13.3.1.4.4.1-3 and 13.3.1.4.5-1 as appropriate.

The UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than Tidentify\_intra\_without\_index\_CCA ms from the beginning of time period T2. The UE is not required to read the neighbour cell SSB index in this test. The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

Tidentify\_intra\_cca\_without\_index = (TPSS/SSS\_sync\_intra\_cca + T SSB\_measurement\_period\_intra\_cca) ms, where

TPSS/SSS\_sync\_intra\_cca: it is the time period used in PSS/SSS detection given in table 10.4.1.0.2.1-1.

T SSB\_measurement\_period\_intra\_cca: equal to a measurement period of SSB based measurement given in table 10.4.1.0.2.2-1.

NOTE:	The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

##### 13.3.2.1	Void

##### 13.3.2.2	Void

##### 13.3.2.3	NR SA FR1-FR1 Event triggered reporting tests on a carrier with CCA without SSB time index detection when DRX is not used

###### 13.3.2.3.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event. This test will partly verify the inter-frequency cell search requirements for NR cell with CCA in clauses 13.3.2.0.1.1 and 13.3.2.0.1.2.

###### 13.3.2.3.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with an unlicensed carrier and RRM measurements on shared channel access.

###### 13.3.2.3.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.3.2.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.3.2.3.

###### 13.3.2.3.4	Test description

In this test, there are three cells: NR Cell 1 as PCell in FR1 on NR RF channel 1, NR Cell 2 as SCell in FR1 with CCA on NR RF channel 2 and NR Cell 3 as neighbour cell in FR1 with CCA on NR RF channel 3. The test parameters are given in Tables 13.3.2.3.4.1-1, 13.3.2.3.4.1-3 and 13.3.2.3.5-1.

In this test, measurement gap pattern configuration # 0 as defined in Table 13.3.2.3.4.1-3 is provided

In the measurement control information, it is indicated to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event A3 is used. The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1, and T2 respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of NR Cell 3.

###### 13.3.2.3.4.2	Test procedure

The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test.

1.	Ensure the UE is in State RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5. Both Cell 1 (PCell) and Cell 2 (SCell) are configured on the UE.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 13.3.2.3.5-1.

3.	SS shall transmit an *RRCConnectionReconfiguration* message with event A3 configured with the corresponding offset according to Table 13.3.2.3.4.1-3.

4.	The UE shall transmit *RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete* message. The SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.3.2.3.5-1. T1 starts.

5.	When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 13.3.2.3.5-1. T2 starts.

6.	UE shall transmit a *MeasurementReport* message triggered by Event A3. If the overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 1602 ms, then the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the required measurement delay, then the number of failure tests is increased by one.

7.	After the SS receive the *MeasurementReport* message in step 6) or when T2 expires, the SS shall:

-	transmit *RRCRelease* message to release the RRC connection.

OR

-	switch the UE off.

8.	The SS shall disable the CCA model (both DL and UL, i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1). Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 3) mod 1008) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

9.	Depending on the choice in Step 7, the SS:

-	if the RRC Connection Release has been sent, transmits in Cell 1 a *Paging* message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE),
OR:

-	if the device has been switched off, switches on the UE.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

In this test, the UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than Tidentify\_inter\_cca\_without\_index from the beginning of time period T2. The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%. The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

The UE is not required to report SSB time index.

Tidentify\_inter\_cca\_without\_index = (TPSS/SSS\_sync\_inter\_cca + T SSB\_measurement\_period\_inter\_cca) ms, where

TPSS/SSS\_sync\_inter\_cca: it is the time period used in PSS/SSS detection given in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.3A.4-1.

T SSB\_measurement\_period\_inter\_cca: equal to a measurement period of SSB based measurement given in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.3A.5-1.

For test 1, MGRP = 40 ms and for test 2 MGRP = 20 ms.

SMTC period = 20 ms.

NOTE:	The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

##### 13.3.2.4	NR SA FR1-FR1 Event triggered reporting tests on a carrier with CCA without SSB time index detection when DRX is used

###### 13.3.2.4.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event. This test will partly verify the inter-frequency cell search requirements for NR cell with CCA in clauses 13.3.2.0.1.1 and 13.3.2.0.1.2.

###### 13.3.2.4.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with an unlicensed carrier and RRM measurements on shared channel access and long DRX cycle.

###### 13.3.2.4.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.3.2.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.3.2.4.

###### 13.3.2.4.4	Test description

In this test, there are three cells: NR Cell 1 as PCell in FR1 on NR RF channel 1, NR Cell 2 as SCell in FR1 with CCA on NR RF channel 2 and NR Cell 3 as neighbour cell in FR1 with CCA on NR RF channel 3. The test parameters are given in Tables 13.3.2.4.4.1-1, 13.3.2.4.4.1-3 and 13.3.2.4.5-1.

In tests 1 and 2, measurement gap pattern configuration # 0 as defined in Table 13.3.2.4.4.1-3 is provided

In the measurement control information, it is indicated to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event A3 is used. The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1, and T2 respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of NR Cell 3.

###### 13.3.2.4.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 13.3.2.4.4.1-1.

1.	The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 13.3.2.4.4.1-3.

2.	Message contents are defined in clause 13.3.2.4.4.3.

3.	There are three cells specified in the test, each on its carrier. Cell 1 is the serving cell (PCell), Cell2 is the SCell and Cell 3 is an inter-frequency neighbour cell. ###### 13.3.2.4.4.2	Test procedure

UE needs to be provided at least once every 500ms with new Timing Advance Command MAC control element to restart the Time alignment timer to keep UE uplink time alignment. Furthermore, UE is allocated with PUSCH resource at every DRX cycle.

The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test.

1.	Ensure the UE is in State RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5. Both Cell 1 (PCell) and Cell 2 (SCell) are configured on the UE.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 13.3.2.4.5-1.

3.	SS shall transmit an *RRCConnectionReconfiguration* message with event A3 configured with the corresponding offset according to Table 13.3.2.4.4.1-3.

4.	The UE shall transmit *RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete* message. The SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.3.2.4.5-1. T1 starts.

5.	When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 13.3.2.4.5-1. T2 starts.

6.	UE shall transmit a *MeasurementReport* message triggered by Event A3. If the overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 2402 ms for Test 1 or less than 16642 ms for Test 2, then the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the required measurement delay, then the number of failure tests is increased by one.

7.	After the SS receive the *MeasurementReport* message in step 6) or when T2 expires, the SS shall:

-	transmit *RRCRelease* message to release the RRC connection.

OR

-	switch the UE off.

8.	The SS shall disable the CCA model (both DL and UL, i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1). Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 3) mod 1008) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

9.	Depending on the choice in Step 7, the SS:

-	if the RRC Connection Release has been sent, transmits in Cell 1 a *Paging* message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE),
OR:

-	if the device has been switched off, switches on the UE.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

11.	Repeat step 1-10 for each sub-test in Tables 13.3.2.4.4.1-3 and 13.3.2.4.5-1 as appropriate.

In test 1, the UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than Tidentify\_inter\_cca\_without\_index from the beginning of time period T2. The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

In test 2, the UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than Tidentify\_inter\_cca\_without\_index from the beginning of time period T2. The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

In test 1 and 2 UE is not required to report SSB time index.

Tidentify\_inter\_cca\_without\_index = (TPSS/SSS\_sync\_inter\_cca + T SSB\_measurement\_period\_inter\_cca) ms, where

TPSS/SSS\_sync\_inter\_cca: it is the time period used in PSS/SSS detection given in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.3A.4-1.

T SSB\_measurement\_period\_inter\_cca: equal to a measurement period of SSB based measurement given in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.3A.5-1.

MGRP = 40 ms.

For test 1 DRX cycle = 40 ms and for test 2 DRX cycle = 640 ms.

SMTC period = 20 ms.

NOTE:	The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

##### 13.3.2.5	NR SA FR1-FR1 Event triggered reporting tests on a carrier with CCA with SSB time index detection when DRX is not used

###### 13.3.2.5.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event. This test will partly verify the inter-frequency cell search requirements for NR cell with CCA in clauses 13.3.2.0.1.1 and 13.3.2.0.1.2.

###### 13.3.2.5.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with an unlicensed carrier and RRM measurements on shared channel access.

###### 13.3.2.5.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.3.2.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.3.2.5.

###### 13.3.2.5.4	Test description

In this test, there are three cells: NR Cell 1 as PCell in FR1 on NR RF channel 1, NR Cell 2 as SCell in FR1 with CCA on NR RF channel 2 and NR Cell 3 as neighbour cell in FR1 with CCA on NR RF channel 3. The test parameters are given in Tables 13.3.2.5.4.1-1, 13.3.2.5.4.1-3 and 13.3.2.5.5-1.

In this test, measurement gap pattern configuration # 0 as defined in Table 13.3.2.5.4.1-3 is provided

In the measurement control information, it is indicated to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event A3 is used. The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1, and T2 respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of NR Cell 3.

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 13.3.2.5.4.1-1.

###### 13.3.2.5.4.2	Test procedure

The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test.

1.	Ensure the UE is in State RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5. Both Cell 1 (PCell) and Cell 2 (SCell) are configured on the UE.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 13.3.2.5.5-1.

3.	SS shall transmit an *RRCConnectionReconfiguration* message with event A3 configured with the corresponding offset according to Table 13.3.2.5.4.1-3.

4.	The UE shall transmit *RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete* message. The SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.3.2.5.5-1. T1 starts.

5.	When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 13.3.2.5.5-1. T2 starts.

6.	UE shall transmit a *MeasurementReport* message triggered by Event A3. If the overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 1922 ms, then the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the required measurement delay, then the number of failure tests is increased by one.

7.	After the SS receive the *MeasurementReport* message in step 6) or when T2 expires, the SS shall:

-	transmit *RRCRelease* message to release the RRC connection.

OR

-	switch the UE off.

8.	The SS shall disable the CCA model (both DL and UL, i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1). Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 3) mod 1008) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

9.	Depending on the choice in Step 7, the SS:

-	if the RRC Connection Release has been sent, transmits in Cell 1 a *Paging* message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE),
OR:

-	if the device has been switched off, switches on the UE.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

The UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than Tidentify\_inter\_cca\_with\_index from the beginning of time period T2. The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

In this test UE is required to report SSB time index.

Tidentify\_inter\_cca\_with\_index = (TPSS/SSS\_sync\_inter\_cca + T SSB\_measurement\_period\_inter\_cca + TSSB\_time\_index\_inter\_cca) ms, where

TPSS/SSS\_sync\_inter\_cca: it is the time period used in PSS/SSS detection given in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.3A.4-1.

TSSB\_time\_index\_inter\_cca: it is the time period used to acquire the index of the SSB being measured given in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.3A.4-2.

T SSB\_measurement\_period\_inter\_cca: equal to a measurement period of SSB based measurement given in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.3A.5-1.

MGRP = 40 ms.

SMTC period = 20 ms.

NOTE:	The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

##### 13.3.2.6	NR SA FR1-FR1 Event triggered reporting tests on a carrier with CCA with SSB time index detection when DRX is used

###### 13.3.2.6.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of an event. This test will partly verify the inter-frequency cell search requirements for NR cell with CCA in clauses 13.3.2.0.1.1 and 13.3.2.0.1.2.

###### 13.3.2.6.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with an unlicensed carrier and RRM measurements on shared channel access and long DRX cycle.

###### 13.3.2.6.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.3.2.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.3.2.6.

###### 13.3.2.6.4	Test description

In this test, there are three cells: NR Cell 1 as PCell in FR1 on NR RF channel 1, NR Cell 2 as SCell in FR1 with CCA on NR RF channel 2 and NR Cell 3 as neighbour cell in FR1 with CCA on NR RF channel 3. The test parameters are given in Tables 13.3.2.6.4.1-1, 13.3.2.6.4.1-3 and 13.3.2.6.5-1.

In tests 1 and 2, measurement gap pattern configuration # 0 as defined in Table 13.3.2.6.4.1-3 is provided

In the measurement control information, it is indicated to the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event A3 is used. The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1, and T2 respectively. During time duration T1, the UE shall not have any timing information of NR Cell 3.

###### 13.3.2.6.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 13.3.2.6.4.1-1.

###### 13.3.2.6.4.2	Test procedure

UE needs to be provided at least once every 500ms with new Timing Advance Command MAC control element to restart the Time alignment timer to keep UE uplink time alignment. Furthermore, UE is allocated with PUSCH resource at every DRX cycle.

The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test.

1.	Ensure the UE is in State RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5. Both Cell 1 (PCell) and Cell 2 (SCell) are configured on the UE.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 13.3.2.6.5-1.

3.	SS shall transmit an *RRCConnectionReconfiguration* message with event A3 configured with the corresponding offset according to Table 13.3.2.6.4.1-3.

4.	The UE shall transmit *RRCConnectionReconfigurationComplete* message. The SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.3.2.6.5-1. T1 starts.

5.	When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 13.3.2.6.5-1. T2 starts.

6.	UE shall transmit a *MeasurementReport* message triggered by Event A3. If the overall delay measured from the beginning of time period T2 is less than 2882 ms for Test 1 or less than 19842 ms for Test 2, then the number of successful tests is increased by one. If the UE fails to report the event within the required measurement delay, then the number of failure tests is increased by one.

7.	After the SS receive the *MeasurementReport* message in step 6) or when T2 expires, the SS shall:

-	transmit *RRCRelease* message to release the RRC connection.

OR

-	switch the UE off.

8.	The SS shall disable the CCA model (both DL and UL, i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1). Set Cell 3 physical cell identity = ((current cell 3 physical cell identity + 3) mod 1008) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

9.	Depending on the choice in Step 7, the SS:

-	if the RRC Connection Release has been sent, transmits in Cell 1 a *Paging* message (including PagingRecord with ue-Identity) for the UE (if the paging fails, switches off and on the UE),
OR:

-	if the device has been switched off, switches on the UE.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

11.	Repeat step 1-10 for each sub-test in Tables 13.3.2.6.4.1-3 and 13.3.2.6.5-1 as appropriate.

|--------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------|

In test 1, the UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than Tidentify\_inter\_cca\_with\_index from the beginning of time period T2. The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

In test 2 with per-FR gap, the UE shall send one Event A3 triggered measurement report, with a measurement reporting delay less than Tidentify\_inter\_cca\_with\_index from the beginning of time period T2. The UE shall not send event triggered measurement reports, as long as the reporting criteria are not fulfilled. The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

In test 1 and 2 UE is required to report SSB time index.

Tidentify\_inter\_cca\_with\_index = (TPSS/SSS\_sync\_inter\_cca + T SSB\_measurement\_period\_inter\_cca + TSSB\_time\_index\_inter\_cca) ms, where

TPSS/SSS\_sync\_inter\_cca: it is the time period used in PSS/SSS detection given in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.3A.4-1.

TSSB\_time\_index\_inter\_cca: it is the time period used to acquire the index of the SSB being measured given in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.3A.4-2.

T SSB\_measurement\_period\_inter\_cca: equal to a measurement period of SSB based measurement given in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.3A.5-1.

MGRP = 40 ms.

For test 1 DRX cycle = 40 ms and for test 2 DRX cycle = 640 ms.

SMTC period = 20 ms.

NOTE:	The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

#### 13.3.3	L1-RSRP measurement for beam reporting for SCell under CCA

##### 13.3.3.0	Minimum Conformance Requirements

Same as section 10.4.3.0.

##### 13.3.3.1	NR SA FR1 SSB based L1-RSRP measurement for SCell under CCA when DRX is not used

###### 13.3.3.1.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of L1-RSRP measurement. This test will partly verify the L1-RSRP measurement requirements in clause 13.3.3.0.

###### 13.3.3.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with a shared spectrum NR carrier and supporting RRM measurements in shared spectrum.

###### 13.3.3.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.3.3.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.3.3.1.

###### 13.3.3.1.4	Test description

There are two cells in the tests, FR1 PCell (Cell 1) and FR1 SCell (Cell 2). Cell 2 operates on a carrier frequency with CCA and transmits SSBs in DBT window according to DL CCA model. The test parameters and applicability for Cell 1 and Cell 2 are given in Table 13.3.3.1.4.1-3 and Table 13.3.3.1.5-1 below.

The same test is applicable for UE supporting any one or both semi-static channel access or dynamic channel access and for network configuring any of semi-static channel occupancy or dynamic channel occupancy.

###### 13.3.3.1.4.2	Test procedure

In CSI measurement configuration, UE is indicated to perform L1-RSRP measurement on the SSBs and report periodically. The UE transmits the reporting according to UL CCA model. The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1 and T2 respectively. The test has higher-layer parameter *timeRestrictionForChannelMeasurements* configured.

There is no measurement gap configured in the test. Before the test, UE is configured to perform RLM, BFD and L1-RSRP measurement based on the SSBs. The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test.

Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to SCell. The UE shall be configured for periodic CSI reporting in PUCCH format 2 with a reporting periodicity as mentioned in the above Table 13.3.3.1.4.1-3.

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On,* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

2.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* message on Cell 1 adding Cell 2 as SCell as specified in section 13.3.3.1.4.3.

3.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration.

4.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 13.3.3.1.5-1. The SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.3.3.1.5-1. T1 starts.

5.	The UE shall be transmitting CSI on PUCCH with a periodicity of 80 slots.

6.	When T1 expires, the SS shall set the parameters according to T2 in 13.3.3.1.5-1. T2 starts.

7.	The UE shall start sending L1-RSRP reports for the SCell. The SS shall check following requirements:

R1:	the UE shall start to transmit valid reports no later than 722 ms from the beginning of time period T2. A valid report shall meet the absolute L1-RSRP requirement for SSB#1 (Table 13.3.3.1.5-2) and the relative L1-RSRP requirement for SSB#0 (Table 13.3.3.1.5-3). If the first valid report is received earlier than the specified time, the number of passed iterations for R1 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failed iterations for R1 is increased by one.

R2:	the UE shall transmit reports every 80 slots until the end of time period T2. If the reports are received accordingly, the number of passed iterations for R2 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failed iterations for R2 is increased by one.

R3:	The L1-RSRP value of SSB#1 reported by the UE is compared to the expected L1-RSRP value for SSB#1. In all consecutive reports after the first valid value is received, if the resulting value is outside the limits in Table 13.3.3.1.5-2 or the UE fails to report the measurement value for SSB#1, the number of failed iterations for R3 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations for R3 is increased by one.

R4:	The DIFF RSRP value of SSB#0 reported by the UE is compared to the expected DIFF RSRP value. In all consecutive reports after the first valid value is received, if the resulting value is outside the limits in Table 13.3.3.1.5-3 or the UE fails to report the measurement value for SSB#0, the number of failed iterations for R4 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations for R4 is increased by one.

8.	The SS waits until T2 expires.

9.	The SS shall transmit *RRCRelease* message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. The SS shall disable the CCA model (both DL and UL, i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1).

10.	The SS shall switch off and then on the UE. Then proceed with step 11.

11.	Repeat steps 1-10 until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

|------------------------------------|------|------|
| Lowest DIFF RSRP reported (SSB#0)  | -    |    0 |

For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values for each requirement (R1 to R4) shall be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%. Each requirement is evaluated independently of the others.

NOTE:	The actual overall delays measured in the test may be up to 2xTTIDCCH higher than the measurement reporting delays above because of TTI insertion uncertainty of the measurement report in DCCH.

##### 13.3.3.2	NR SA FR1 SSB based L1-RSRP measurement for SCell under CCA when DRX is used

###### 13.3.3.2.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of L1-RSRP measurement. This test will partly verify the L1-RSRP measurement requirements in clause 13.3.3.0.

###### 13.3.3.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with a shared spectrum NR carrier and supporting RRM measurements in shared spectrum and long DRX cycle.

###### 13.3.3.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.3.3.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.3.3.2.

###### 13.3.3.2.4	Test description

There are two cells in the tests, FR1 PCell (Cell 1) and FR1 SCell (Cell 2). Cell 2 operates on a carrier frequency with CCA and transmits SSBs in DBT window according to DL CCA model. The test parameters and applicability for Cell 1 and Cell 2 are given in Table 13.3.3.2.4.1-3 and Table 13.3.3.2.5-1 below.

The same test is applicable for UE supporting any one or both semi-static channel access or dynamic channel access and for network configuring any of semi-static channel occupancy or dynamic channel occupancy.

###### 13.3.3.2.4.2	Test procedure

In CSI measurement configuration, UE is indicated to perform L1-RSRP measurement on the SSBs and report periodically. The UE transmits the reporting according to UL CCA model. The test consists of two successive time periods, with time duration of T1 and T2 respectively. The test has higher-layer parameter *timeRestrictionForChannelMeasurements* configured.

There is no measurement gap configured in the test. Before the test, UE is configured to perform RLM, BFD and L1-RSRP measurement based on the SSBs. The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test.

Prior to the start of the time duration T1, the UE shall be fully synchronized to SCell. The UE shall be configured for periodic CSI reporting in PUCCH format 2 with a reporting periodicity as mentioned in the above Table 13.3.3.2.4.1-3.

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On,* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

2.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* message on Cell 1 adding Cell 2 as SCell as specified in section 13.3.3.2.4.3.

3.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration.

4.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 13.3.3.2.5-1. The SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.3.3.2.5-1. T1 starts.

5.	The UE shall be transmitting CSI on PUCCH with a periodicity of 80 slots.

6.	When T1 expires, the SS shall set the parameters according to T2 in 13.3.3.2.5-1. T2 starts.

7.	The UE shall start sending L1-RSRP reports for the SCell. The SS shall check following requirements:

R1:	the UE shall start to transmit valid reports no later than 722 ms from the beginning of time period T2. A valid report shall meet the absolute L1-RSRP requirement for SSB#1 (Table 13.3.3.2.5-2) and the relative L1-RSRP requirement for SSB#0 (Table 13.3.3.2.5-3). If the first valid report is received earlier than the specified time, the number of passed iterations for R1 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failed iterations for R1 is increased by one.

R2:	the UE shall transmit reports every 80 slots until the end of time period T2. If the reports are received accordingly, the number of passed iterations for R2 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failed iterations for R2 is increased by one.

R3:	The L1-RSRP value of SSB#1 reported by the UE is compared to the expected L1-RSRP value for SSB#1. In all consecutive reports after the first valid value is received, if the resulting value is outside the limits in Table 13.3.3.2.5-2 or the UE fails to report the measurement value for SSB#1, the number of failed iterations for R3 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations for R3 is increased by one.

R4:	The DIFF RSRP value of SSB#0 reported by the UE is compared to the expected DIFF RSRP value. In all consecutive reports after the first valid value is received, if the resulting value is outside the limits in Table 13.3.3.2.5-3 or the UE fails to report the measurement value for SSB#0, the number of failed iterations for R4 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations for R4 is increased by one.

8.	The SS waits until T2 expires.

9.	The SS shall transmit *RRCRelease* message to release the RRC connection which includes the release of the established radio bearers as well as all radio resources. The SS shall disable the CCA model (both DL and UL, i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1).

10.	The SS shall switch off and then on the UE. Then proceed with step 11.

11.	Repeat steps 1-10 until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

##### 13.4.1.1	NR SA FR1 SS-RSRP measurement accuracy on a carrier with CCA

###### 13.4.1.1.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the SS-RSRP measurement accuracy on the carrier frequency with CCA is within the specified limits. This test will partially verify the SS-RSRP measurement accuracy requirements in section 13.4.1.0.1 and 13.4.1.0.2.

###### 13.4.1.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with a shared spectrum NR carrier and supporting RRM.

###### 13.4.1.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.4.1.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.4.1.1.

###### 13.4.1.1.4	Test description

Three cells are deployed in the test, which are FR1 PCell (Cell 1), and two cells on the same carrier frequency with CCA and transmit SSBs in DBT windows according to DL CCA model: SCell (Cell 2) and a neighbour cell (Cell 3). Supported test configurations are shown in Table 13.4.1.1.4.1-1. Both absolute and relative accuracy of SS-RSRP intra-frequency measurements are tested by using the parameters in Tables 13.4.1.1.5-1, 13.4.1.1.5-2 and 13.4.1.1.5-3.

###### 13.4.1.1.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 13.4.1.1.4.1-1.

1.	The test parameter settings are set up according to Tables 13.4.1.1.5-1 and 13.4.1.1.5-2.

2.	Message contents are defined in clause 13.4.1.1.4.3.

3.	Cell 1, Cell 2 and Cell 3 are NR cells with power levels set according to clauses C.1.2 and C.1.3. In addition, Cell 2 and Cell 3 are on an unlicensed carrier subject to CCA.

###### 13.4.1.1.4.2	Test procedure

The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test. The SS shall provide sufficient UL grants to the UE such that no SR is required for measurement reporting.

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On,* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

2.	Set the parameters according to Table 13.4.1.1.5-1 as appropriate.

3.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* message on Cell 1 adding Cell 2 as SCell as specified in section 13.4.1.1.4.3.

4.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration.

5.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* on Cell 1 configuring the UE to perform intra-frequency SS-RSRP measurements on the SCC as specified in section 13.4.1.1.4.3.

6.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration. Afterwards, the SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.4.1.1.5-1.

7.	The UE shall transmit periodical *MeasurementReport* messages.

8.	After 10s wait from Step 5, the SS shall check the SS-RSRP reported values in the periodic *MeasurementReport* . The SS-RSRP value of Cell 3 reported by the UE is compared to the expected SS-RSRP. If the value is outside the limits in Tables 13.4.1.1.5-2 and 13.4.1.1.5-3 or the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 3, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations is increased by one.

9.	The SS shall continue checking the *MeasurementReport* messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 for each Test in Table 13.4.1.1.5-1 as appropriate.

##### 13.4.2.1	NR SA FR1 SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy on a carrier with CCA

###### 13.4.2.1.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy on the carrier frequency with CCA is within the specified limits. This test will partially verify the SS-RSRQ measurement accuracy requirements in section 13.4.2.0.1.

###### 13.4.2.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with a shared spectrum NR carrier and supporting RRM in shared spectrum.

###### 13.4.2.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.4.2.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.4.2.1.

###### 13.4.2.1.4	Test description

Three cells are deployed in the test, which are FR1 PCell (Cell 1), and two cells on the same carrier frequency with CCA and transmit SSBs in DBT windows according to DL CCA model: SCell (Cell 2) and a neighbour cell (Cell 3). Supported test configurations are shown in Table 13.4.2.1.4.1-1. The absolute accuracy of SS-RSRQ intra-frequency measurements is tested by using the parameters in Tables 13.4.2.1.5-1 and 13.4.2.1.5-2.

###### 13.4.2.1.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 13.4.2.1.4.1-1.

1.	The test parameter settings are set up according to Tables 13.4.2.1.5-1 and 13.4.2.1.5-2.

2.	Message contents are defined in clause 13.4.2.1.4.3.

3.	Cell 1, Cell 2 and Cell 3 are NR cells with power levels set according to clauses C.1.2 and C.1.3. In addition, Cell 2 and Cell 3 are on an unlicensed carrier subject to CCA.

###### 13.4.2.1.4.2	Test procedure

The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test. The SS shall provide sufficient UL grants to the UE such that no SR is required for measurement reporting.

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On,* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

2.	Set the parameters according to Table 13.4.2.1.5-1 as appropriate.

3.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* message on Cell 1 adding Cell 2 as SCell as specified in section 13.4.2.1.4.3.

4.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration.

5.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* on Cell 1 configuring the UE to perform intra-frequency SS-RSRQ measurements on the SCC as specified in section 13.4.2.1.4.3.

6.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration. Afterwards, the SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.4.2.1.5-1.

7.	The UE shall transmit periodical *MeasurementReport* messages.

8.	After 10s wait from Step 5, the SS shall check the SS-RSRQ reported values in the periodic *MeasurementReport* . The SS-RSRQ value of Cell 3 reported by the UE is compared to the expected SS-RSRQ. If the value is outside the limits in Table 13.4.2.1.5-2 or the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 3, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations is increased by one.

9.	The SS shall continue checking the *MeasurementReport* messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 for each Test in Table 13.4.2.1.5-1 as appropriate.

##### 13.4.3.1	NR SA FR1 SS-SINR measurement accuracy on a carrier with CCA

###### 13.4.3.1.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the SS-SINR measurement accuracy on the carrier frequency with CCA is within the specified limits. This test will partially verify the SS-SINR measurement accuracy requirements in section 13.4.3.0.1.

###### 13.4.3.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with a shared spectrum NR carrier and supporting RRM and SS-SINR measurements on shared spectrum.

###### 13.4.3.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.4.3.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.4.3.1.

###### 13.4.3.1.4	Test description

Three cells are deployed in the test, which are FR1 PCell (Cell 1), and two cells on the same carrier frequency with CCA and transmit SSBs in DBT windows according to DL CCA model: SCell (Cell 2) and a neighbour cell (Cell 3). Supported test configurations are shown in Table 13.4.3.1.4.1-1. The absolute accuracy of SS-SINR intra-frequency measurements is tested by using the parameters in Tables 13.4.3.1.5-1, 13.4.3.1.5-2 and 13.4.3.1.5-3. Two sub-tests (Test 1 and Test 2) are provided different Noc on Cells 1, 2, and 3.

###### 13.4.3.1.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 13.4.3.1.4.1-1.

2.	Message contents are defined in clause 13.4.3.1.4.3.

3.	Cell 1, Cell 2 and Cell 3 are NR cells with power levels set according to clauses C.1.2 and C.1.3. In addition, Cell 2 and Cell 3 are on an unlicensed carrier subject to CCA.

###### 13.4.3.1.4.2	Test procedure

The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test. The SS shall provide sufficient UL grants to the UE such that no SR is required for measurement reporting.

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On,* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

2.	Set the parameters according to Tables 13.4.3.1.5-1 and 13.4.3.1.5-2 as appropriate.

3.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* message on Cell 1 adding Cell 2 as SCell as specified in section 13.4.3.1.4.3.

4.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration.

5.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* on Cell 1 configuring the UE to perform intra-frequency SS-SINR measurements on the SCC as specified in section 13.4.3.1.4.3.

6.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration. Afterwards, the SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.4.3.1.5-1.

7.	The UE shall transmit periodical *MeasurementReport* messages.

8.	After 10s wait from Step 5, the SS shall check the SS-SINR reported values in the periodic *MeasurementReport* . The SS-SINR value of Cell 3 reported by the UE is compared to the expected SS-SINR. If the value is outside the limits in Table 13.4.3.1.5-2 or the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 3, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations is increased by one.

9.	The SS shall continue checking the *MeasurementReport* messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 for each Test in Table 13.4.3.1.5-1 as appropriate.

| Lowest reported value (Cell 3)  | SS-SINR_31         | SS-SINR_28         |
| Highest reported value (Cell 3) | SS-SINR_49         | SS-SINR_45         |
| Extreme Conditions              | Extreme Conditions | Extreme Conditions |
| Lowest reported value (Cell 3)  | SS-SINR_30         | SS-SINR_27         |
| Highest reported value (Cell 3) | SS-SINR_50         | SS-SINR_46         |

For the test to pass, the ratio of successful reported values in each test shall be more than 90% with a confidence level of 95%.

#### 13.4.4	L1-RSRP measurement for beam reporting with CCA serving cell

##### 13.4.4.0	Minimum Conformance Requirements

###### 13.4.4.0.1	SSB-based L1-RSRP measurement absolute accuracy under CCA

Same as section 10.5.4.0.1.1.

###### 13.4.4.0.2	SSB-based L1-RSRP measurement relative accuracy under CCA

Same as section 10.5.4.0.1.2.

##### 13.4.4.1	NR SA FR1 L1-RSRP measurement accuracy for beam reporting on a carrier with CCA

###### 13.4.4.1.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the L1-RSRP measurement accuracy on the carrier frequency with CCA is within the specified limits. This test will partially verify the L1-RSRP measurement accuracy requirements in section 13.4.4.0.1 and 13.4.4.0.2.

###### 13.4.4.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with a shared spectrum NR carrier and supporting RRM and UL with a shared spectrum NR carrier.

###### 13.4.4.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.4.4.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.4.4.1.

###### 13.4.4.1.4	Test description

In this set of test cases there are two cells in the test, PCell (Cell 1) and a SCell under CCA (Cell2). Cell 2 operates on a carrier frequency with CCA and transmits SSBs in DBT window according to DL CCA model.

Two sub-tests (Test 1 and Test 2) are provided with different *Noc* on Cell 2. The test parameters for the Cell 1 and Cell 2 as well as the absolute and relative accuracy of L1-RSRP measurements are tested by using the parameters in Tables 13.4.4.1.5-1, 13.4.4.1.5-2 and 13.4.4.1.5-3.

The same test is applicable for UE supporting any one or both semi-static channel access or dynamic channel access and for network configuring any of semi-static channel occupancy or dynamic channel occupancy.

There is no measurement gap configured in the test. Before the test, UE is configured one SSB resource set with two SSB resources. On Cell 2, UE is configured to perform L1-RSRP measurement based on the SSB resources 0 and 1.

2.	Message contents are defined in clause 13.4.4.1.4.3.

3.	Cell 1 and Cell 2 are NR cells with power levels set according to clauses C.1.2 and C.1.3. In addition, Cell 2 is on an unlicensed carrier subject to CCA.

###### 13.4.4.1.4.2	Test procedure

The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test. The SS shall provide sufficient UL grants to the UE such that no SR is required for measurement reporting.

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On,* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

2.	Set the parameters according to Table 13.4.4.1.5-1 as appropriate.

3.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* message on Cell 1 adding Cell 2 as SCell as specified in section 13.4.4.1.4.3.

4.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration.

5.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* on Cell 1 configuring the UE to perform L1-RSRP measurements on the SCell as specified in section 13.4.4.1.4.3.

6.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration. Afterwards, the SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.4.4.1.5-1.

7.	The UE shall transmit periodical PUCCH format 2 CSI reports containing L1-RSRP measurements for the SCell every 80 slots.

8.	After 10s wait from Step 6, the SS shall check the L1-RSRP reported values in the periodic CSI reports:

R1:	The SS shall check the L1-RSRP reported values of SSB#0 or SSB#1 in the periodic L1-RSRP reports. If the value for the strongest SSB is within the limits in Table 13.4.4.1.5-2, the number of passed iterations is increased by one, otherwise the number of failed iterations is increased by one.

R2:	The SS shall check the L1-RSRP reported values of SSB#0 and SSB#1 in the periodic L1-RSRP reports. The DIFF-RSRP value of SSB#0 or SSB#1 reported by the UE is compared to the expected DIFF-RSRP. If the DIFF-RSRP value is within the limits in Table 13.4.4.1.5-3, the number of passed iterations is increased by one, otherwise the number of failed iterations is increased by one.

9.	The SS shall continue checking the L1-RSRP reports transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 for each Test in Table 13.4.4.1.5-1 as appropriate.

#### 13.4.5	RSSI

##### 13.4.5.0	Minimum Conformance Requirements

###### 13.4.5.0.1	Intra-frequency absolute RSSI measurement accuracy requirements in FR1

Same as section 10.5.5.0.1.

###### 13.4.5.0.2	Inter-frequency absolute RSSI measurement accuracy requirements in FR1

Same as section 10.5.5.0.2.

###### 13.4.5.0.3	RSSI measurement report mapping

The reporting range of RSSI measurement is defined from -100 dBm to -25 dBm with 1 dBm resolution.

The mapping of the measured quantity is defined in Table 13.4.5.0.3-1. The range in the signalling may be larger than the guaranteed accuracy range, provided that the following condition is met:

the RSSI measurement bandwidth is the channel bandwidth defined in Clause 4 of TS 37.213 [37], where the channel has the center frequency configured by *ARFCN-valueNR* .

Table 13.4.5.0.3-1: RSSI measurement report mapping

| Reported value   | Measured quantity value   | Unit   |
|------------------|---------------------------|--------|
| RSSI_00          | RSSI < -100               | dBm    |
| RSSI_01          | -100  RSSI < -99          | dBm    |
| RSSI_02          | -99  RSSI < -98           | dBm    |
| …                | …                         | …      |
| RSSI_74          | -27  RSSI < -26           | dBm    |
| RSSI_75          | -26  RSSI < -25           | dBm    |
| RSSI_76          | -25  RSSI                 | dBm    |

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.1.34.3.

##### 13.4.5.1	NR SA FR1 RSSI measurement accuracy on a carrier with CCA

###### 13.4.5.1.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the RSSI measurement accuracy is within the specified limits. This test will partially verify the RSSI measurement accuracy requirements in section 13.4.5.0.1.

###### 13.4.5.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR UE release 16 and forward, supporting 2DL CA with a shared spectrum NR carrier and supporting RRM and Channel occupancy measurements on shared channel access.

###### 13.4.5.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 13.4.5.0.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.13.4.5.1.

###### 13.4.5.1.4	Test description

In all test cases, Cell 1 is the PCell on a licensed FR1 band and Cell 2 is the SCell with CCA. RSSI is measured on channel number 2. Supported test configurations are shown in Table 13.4.5.1.4.1-1. The accuracy of RSSI intra-frequency measurements is tested by using the parameters in Tables 13.4.5.1.5-1, 13.4.5.1.5-2 and 13.4.5.1.5-3.

###### 13.4.5.1.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 13.4.5.1.4.1-1.

Table 13.4.5.1.4.1-1: Supported test configurations for NR SA FR1 RSSI measurement accuracy on a carrier with CCA

| Configuration   | Description                                                                                                                |
|-----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 13.4.5.1-1      | Without CCA: 15 kHz SSB SCS, 10 MHz bandwidth, FDD duplex mode With CCA: 30 kHz SSB SCS, 40 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode |
| 13.4.5.1-2      | Without CCA: 15 kHz SSB SCS, 10 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode With CCA: 30 kHz SSB SCS, 40 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode |
| 13.4.5.1-3      | Without CCA: 30 kHz SSB SCS, 40 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode With CCA: 30 kHz SSB SCS, 40 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode |
| NOTE:	The UE is only required to be tested in one of the supported test configurations.                 | NOTE:	The UE is only required to be tested in one of the supported test configurations.                                                                                                                            |

Configure the test equipment and the DUT according to the parameters in Table 13.4.5.1.4.1-2.

1.	The test parameter settings are set up according to Tables 13.4.5.1.5-1 and 13.4.5.1.5-2.

2.	Message contents are defined in clause 13.4.5.1.4.3.

3.	Cell 1 and Cell 2 are NR cells with power levels set according to clauses C.1.2 and C.1.3. In addition, Cell 2 is on an unlicensed carrier subject to CCA.

###### 13.4.5.1.4.2	Test procedure

The CCA model (both DL and UL) is disabled (i.e. PCCA\_DL\_i= PCCA\_UL=1) at the start of the test. The SS shall provide sufficient UL grants to the UE such that no SR is required for measurement reporting.

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On,* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

2.	Set the parameters according to Table 13.4.5.1.5-1 as appropriate.

3.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* message on Cell 1 adding Cell 2 as SCell as specified in section 13.4.5.1.4.3.

4.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration.

5.	The SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* on Cell 1 configuring the UE to perform intra-frequency RSSI measurements on the SCC according to the RMTC specified in section 13.4.5.1.4.3.

6.	The UE shall transmit an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* to acknowledge the configuration. Afterwards, the SS shall enable DL and UL CCA model according to Table 13.4.5.1.5-1.

7.	The UE shall transmit periodical *MeasurementReport* messages.

8.	After 10s wait from Step 5, the SS shall check the RSSI reported values in the periodic *MeasurementReport* . The RSSI value of Cell 2 reported by the UE is compared to the expected RSSI. If the value is outside the limits in Table 13.4.5.1.5-3 or the UE fails to report the measurement value for Cell 2, the number of failed iterations is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations is increased by one.

9.	The SS shall continue checking the *MeasurementReport* messages transmitted by the UE until the confidence level according to Annex G clause G.2.7 is achieved.

10.	Repeat steps 1-9 for each Test in Table 13.4.5.1.5-1 as appropriate.
